bagPolicy.summary: Toyota Center encourages fans to travel light, allowing only small bags no larger than 10" x 6" x 2", diaper bags, and medical bags. All bags are subject to search and must use designated entrances.
allowed: bags no larger than 10" x 6" x 2"
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags and diaper bags are exceptions to the size restriction.

parking.note: Toyota Center offers a dedicated 2,500-space parking garage called the Toyota Tundra Garage, which is cashless and has a private sky bridge for premium guests. Garage parking is not available for non-passholders on Houston Rockets game days. Surface parking lots and street parking are also available nearby.

rideshare.note: Head West towards Austin St, on the other side of Root Memorial Square Park to pick up your Lyft.

concessions.note: Food and alcoholic beverages are sold inside Toyota Center. Outside alcohol is prohibited, and all points of sale are cashless; event-specific service restrictions can apply.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: Fully ADA compliant. Wheelchair seating on all levels. Accessible parking and drop-off. Elevators and ramps throughout.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Box Office at Toyota Center, check event details for hours. Photo ID required.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Multiple gates around the arena. Located at 1510 Polk St, Houston.
